name: Dwarf Mallow
desc: Dwarf Mallow (Malva neglecta): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Malva neglecta is a species of plant of the family Malvaceae, native to most of the Old World except sub-Saharan Africa. It is an annual growing to 0.6 m (2 ft).
